# Zenith DAW Issue Templates

This directory contains GitHub issue templates for the Zenith DAW project. These templates help ensure consistent and comprehensive issue reporting.

## Available Templates

### Bug Report (`bug_report.yml`)
- For reporting bugs and issues
- Includes severity levels, reproduction steps, and environment details
- Automatically assigned the "bug" label

### Feature Request (`feature_request.yml`)
- For suggesting new features
- Includes use cases, mockups, and priority information
- Automatically assigned the "enhancement" label

### Improvement (`improvement.yml`)
- For suggesting improvements to existing functionality
- Includes implementation ideas and code examples
- Automatically assigned the "improvement" label

### Documentation (`document.yml`)
- For reporting documentation issues or requesting improvements
- Includes location information and suggested improvements
- Automatically assigned the "documentation" label

## Usage

1. When creating a new issue, GitHub will prompt you to use one of these templates
2. Fill out all required fields marked with `(*)`
3. Provide as much detail as possible to help maintainers understand and resolve the issue
4. Attach screenshots, log files, or other relevant files when appropriate

## Configuration

The `config.yml` file configures the issue template system and defines quick links for common issue types.

## Best Practices

- Be specific and provide detailed information
- Include reproduction steps for bugs
- Provide use cases for feature requests
- Include screenshots or screen recordings when helpful
- Check existing issues before creating new ones
